{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check for non-numeric values in 'revenue' after removing whitespace
print('Unique values in revenue (before cleaning):', df['revenue'].unique())

# Strip whitespace and convert to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue_clean'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'].str.strip(), errors='coerce')

# Check how many conversion errors occurred
print('Number of invalid revenue entries (converted to NaN):', df['revenue_clean'].isna().sum())

# Show the first few rows with the cleaned column
df[['revenue', 'revenue_clean']].head(10)"}
